pages.text: Our Products | empayit top of page empayit Home New Home Our Story Our Services Our Products Contact Us More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. OUR PRODUCTS mobile ticketing The next generation for bus, train and tram ticketing The empayit technology is a cloud-based, turnkey, mobile payment platform designed for any kind of merchant to accept secure mobile payments from any type of mobile phone. ​ Non-smart phone users makes payments for, as an example bus tickets, by simply sending a text message and smart phone users can purchase a bus ticket by choosing ticket type in an application user interface. retail payments Making mobile retail quick, easy and secure Our retail payment solution makes it easy for merchants to accept mobile payments from customers. ​ We partner with the best minds in emerging markets to roll out mobile payment solutions that boost retail and promote financial inclusion. event ticketing Mobile solution for event ticketing Get real-time data on customer numbers and a direct channel to each customer with our high-volume event ticketing solution. ​ Customers buy tickets directly from their mobile phones and get electronic tickets and event notifications. Quick and easy to use. utility bill payment Freedom to pay all your bills from your mobile phone A convenient and easy way to pay your monthly bills for electricity, water, central heating, telephone, cable, internet and digital TV without visiting your bank or billing company. mobile voucher Mobile vouchers, coupons and loyalty cards Mobile ticketing technology can also be used for the distribution of vouchers, coupons, and loyalty cards. These items are represented by a virtual token that is sent to the mobile phone. A customer presenting a mobile phone with one of these tokens at the point of sale receives the same benefits as if they had the traditional coupon or voucher. PSP and digital wallet Together with our partners, we offer: PSP Services Online services for accepting electronic payments by a variety of payment methods including mobile money, credit card , bank-based payments such as direct debit , bank transfer , and real-time bank transfer based on online banking . We integrate the payment methods chosen by our clients (merchants). ​ Typically, PSP can connect to multiple acquiring banks , card, and payment networks . In many cases, the PSP will fully manage these technical connections, relationships with the external network, and bank accounts. This makes the merchant less dependent on financial institutions and free from the task of establishing these connections directly, especially when operating internationally. PSP fees are typically levied in one of two ways: as a percentage of each transaction or a fixed cost per transaction. ​ Digital wallet Empayit offers a dedicated digital wallet that holds cash and cards along with a clients mobile phone number. This wallet-based systems enable the widespread use of digital wallet transactions among various retail vendors in the form of mobile payments systems and digital wallet applications. ​ Our digital wallet requires minimal setup and is easy to use. Once the software is installed, the user begins by entering all the pertinent information and creates an account. The digital wallet is now set up. Next step is to add funds to the account. At the purchase or check-out page of an e-commerce site or at a POS, the payment of a good or service will be performed by debiting the users stored value account.
